title: Features
description: Switch off what you don't use. Nothing is deleted, and switching it back on brings it all back.

orders.label: Orders
orders.description: Guests add dishes to a cart and send you the order on WhatsApp.
orders.offNote: Guests can't order from your menu while this is off. Orders you already have stay saved.

variants.label: Variants
variants.description: Choices on a dish, like size or spice level. Guests pick one, and each can add to the price.
variants.offNote: Your menu shows dishes without their variants while this is off. Your variants are kept.

addons.label: Add-ons
addons.description: Extras guests can add to a dish, like extra cheese, each with its own price.
addons.offNote: Your menu shows dishes without their add-ons while this is off. Your add-ons are kept.

qr.label: QR Studio
qr.description: Colours, shapes, your logo and a printable table card for your QR code.
qr.offNote: Your plain black QR code stays on the QR code page, ready to download. Your design is kept.

analytics.label: Analytics
analytics.description: How guests find your menu and what they do on it.

languages.label: Multiple languages
languages.description: Your menu in English and one more language, with a switch for guests.
languages.offNote: Your menu shows English only. What you wrote in the other language is kept.
languages.secondHint: Changing it keeps what you wrote in the old language.
languages.saveFailed: Could not save your menu languages
